docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Surendranath Dasgupta (1887–1952), professor at Calcutta and Cambridge, wrote the first full history of Indian philosophy in English. This first volume covers the Vedic and Upaniṣadic thought and the Buddhist, Jain and classical systems, drawing on the original texts and their commentaries.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Surendranath Dasgupta (1887–1952), A History of Indian Philosophy, volume 1 (Cambridge University Press, 1922), as proofread on English Wikisource by its contributors.
